breakdown.note: Separate partitions of the same selected-source total; never add the two axes. Long-term = event duration >=30 days. End year >=2100 in Europe/Berlin is an open-ended marker, not proof of retirement. Overlapping notices with different classifications are mixed/unknown.

kpi.scope: A80 generation units; A77 fallback · DE-LU + FR + NL + BE

data.methodology: A80 is used when available. A77 is only a fallback because a production unit can aggregate generation units; A77 and A80 are never added together. Overlapping notices for the same resource contribute the maximum unavailable MW, not their sum. This is a selected-source monitor, not a full A77+A80 inventory.

12.3.E.scope: 4 German LFA/SCA · A67/A68 aFRR · A60/A61 mFRR

data.note: A24 uses four German LFA/SCA. A67/A68 (aFRR) and A60/A61 (mFRR) take precedence over A51/A47 per area, product, direction and MTU, including zero. Offered-only rows are not activation. Missing sources are reported, never zero-filled; Germany totals require all four areas and both directions. Available area series remain visible. A86 is MWh; A24 is MW.
